# `SB_INDEX_UNREACHABLE`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | error |
| Area | [Storybook (`SB_`)](README.md#domain-sb) |
| Reported by | `storybook` |

## What happened

`index.json`/`stories.json` could not be loaded; aborts the run (`data.fatal: true`, exit 3).

## What to do

Check the URL and that Storybook is running. For a static build, run `storybook build` and point Holotype at `storybook-static/`.
